name: GoLab Courier Center Integration for WooCommerce
author: dimitrisgolabacademy

sections.description:
GoLab Courier Center Integration for WooCommerce is the ultimate tool for e-shops collaborating with Courier Center in Greece. It allows you to fully automate your order shipping process for both domestic and international shipments, saving time and preventing errors.

Through direct integration with the Qualco Deliverd API, the plugin dynamically calculates shipping costs at Checkout based on the physical and volumetric weight of the products. It supports flat rates for Greece/Cyprus and official automated pricing for 43 European destinations! It also allows you to generate, cancel, and print the shipping Waybill (Voucher) with a single click.

✨ Key Features:

  • Dynamic Cost Calculation: Automatic calculation of the volumetric and actual weight of the cart products (charges based on the highest weight with a 5000 divider).
  • Greece, Cyprus & Europe Support: Different pricing policies (Flat rates) for Greece and Cyprus, plus fully automated official DHL/UPS pricing zones for 43 European countries.
  • Dynamic Brand Renaming: Automatically displays “UPS Courier” at checkout for European customers to boost international trust, while keeping “Courier Center” for Greece and Cyprus.
  • Cash on Delivery (COD) Fee: Automatically adds a fixed fee (3.00€) when the customer selects Cash on Delivery with the supported couriers.
  • 1-Click Voucher Generation & Cancellation: Generate and void the tracking number in the Courier Center system instantly from the WooCommerce order edit screen.
  • Print PDF Label: Download and print the official Voucher PDF directly from the WooCommerce interface, without logging into Web Shipping.
  • Dynamic Sender Account: Option to route billing to specific branch accounts (e.g., 209-0119-0002).
  • HPOS Compatibility: Fully optimized for the new WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

Turn your e-shop into a shipping machine and offer the best experience to your customers globally!
sections.installation:
1. Go to the Plugins > Add New Plugin menu in WordPress.
  2. Upload the compressed plugin file (zip) and click Install and Activate.
  3. Go to the WooCommerce > Courier Center API menu and fill in your API keys (User Alias, Password, API Key) and optionally your Sender Account.
  4. In Shipping Zones (WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping), add a “Flat Rate” method, name it exactly Courier Center, and leave the cost empty. The plugin will handle the calculations and dynamic renaming automatically!
sections.faq:
Do I need a Courier Center account?

Yes, an active Web Shipping account (Qualco Deliverd) and the corresponding API Credentials are required to issue Vouchers.

How is the Volumetric Weight calculated?

The system reads the product dimensions (LxWxH) and uses the international divider (5000) to find the volumetric weight. It compares it with the actual weight and charges based on the higher value.

How does European shipping work?

The plugin automatically detects if the customer is in one of the 43 supported European countries, calculates the volumetric weight, and applies the official Courier Center (DHL) Zone pricing, including your custom discounts and fuel surcharges.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Major International Shipping Update.
  • Added support for 43 European countries (Zones 1, 2, 3) based on official DHL/UPS pricing.
  • Added dynamic checkout branding: Automatically renames the shipping method to “UPS Courier” for European countries to boost customer trust.
  • Automated European price calculation applying a flat +22% markup over the base zone rates (incorporating discounts and fuel surcharges).
  • Fixed COD fee to apply conditionally (3.00€) for both Courier Center and UPS Courier labels.
  • Added “Cancel Voucher” (Void) button functionality in the order screen.
  • Added Dynamic Sender/Billing Account support for specific branch routing.
  • Added virtual box dimensional calculations for accurate API requests.

1.2.0

  • Added API settings options in the WooCommerce interface.
  • Improved volumetric weight calculation algorithm.
  • Added built-in documentation.

1.0.0

  • Initial plugin release.
